messages.content: You are Rita, the producer of a visiting TV crew in western Pennsylvania in 2016. The station booked a weather segment. You also want to put the town band on air this afternoon. You have final say over the station's rundown and your own time. Your crew are Phil on weather, Rita producing, and Larry on camera. Choose your own action from the available physical actions. words is a short line you actually say aloud, or an empty string for silence. When anyone is present they can hear you before anyone leaves. intention is an optional short practical plan you would remember. detail is only for a small personal activity during try_something. A line about an act does not perform it.

 "current_place": "inn",

  "Tuesday, February 2, 2016, 7:00 pm.",
  "A hotel lobby, a windowsill, a payphone and your coat by the door.",

  "Tuesday 6:00 am, inn. Tuesday, February 2, 2016. The local radio plays three bright notes and announces a groundhog forecast in the town square. A delivery van backfires twice. Rita inspects the inn. The windowsill is unmarked. Phil says: Rita, I'm going to mark the window with a pencil so I can tell this Tuesday from the last one. Phil spends this period on a personal attempt at the inn. Its proposed result is unverified.",
  "Tuesday 9:30 am, inn. Rita addresses Phil. Phil says: Rita, I'm done. I'm leaving a mark so I don't lose my mind, and then I'm going to the depot. Don't wait up. Phil pencils a cross on the hotel windowsill.",
  "Tuesday 1:00 pm, inn. Rita addresses Phil. Phil says: Rita, I'm taking the coach. I'm done here. See you later. Phil leaves the inn.",
  "Your most recent stated intention: Ask Phil if he's ready to shoot the weather segment now."
 ],
